  WARNING   entry 0  Name is only in the Common Name [name.cn_only_no_san]
            The certificate names its subject only in the Common Name and has no Subject Alternative Name extension, or the certificate signing request asks for no Subject Alternative Names. Modern TLS clients ignore the Common Name when they match host names.
            Evidence: common_name=cn-only.example.test
            Fix: Reissue the certificate, or create a new certificate signing request, with its names in the Subject Alternative Name extension.
